selectionRule: For every observed venue x calendarMonth stratum in the fixed 7695-race archive, compute SHA256(seed|raceDate|venue) for every raceDate x venue group, sort ascending, and select max(1, round(groupCount * 0.20)) venue-days. This deterministic rule is the canonical source of the split; no hand-maintained group list is authoritative.
causalTrainingRule: For each evaluated holdout venue-day, training may use only non-holdout observations with raceDate strictly earlier than the evaluated raceDate. Future dates and same-date outcomes are forbidden. Holdout outcomes are never added to training for later holdout predictions.
coldStart: Included. If insufficient prior training exists, use the pre-fixed cold-start policy; do not drop the venue-day.
